$comment: Theme CSS is its own option surface, outside the top-level highlighting API.
Rust CssBuilder, JavaScript buildCss, Elixir Lumis.Theme.build_css/2 and CLI themes build-css must accept every option.
Names are snake_case in Rust and Elixir, camelCase in JavaScript; cli names are flags. Boolean CLI flags negate the true default.
Tests check option inventories in both directions, defaults, and these exact CSS bytes. Add options here before implementing them.
layout=false removes only the built-in layout layer; theme styles and explicit container_style declarations stay. Prebuilt stylesheets retain layout.
